description: React hook 'useChatApi' that manages chat sessions, file uploads, and message interactions with backend APIs, acting as a connector between UI components and backend services.

methods.name: loadSessions
methods.description: Fetches and updates the list of chat sessions from the backend API.

methods.name: loadFiles
methods.description: Loads files associated with a specific session.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new chat session and resets related local state.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches the active chat session and resets messages.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a specific file from the session.

methods.name: uploadFiles
methods.description: Uploads multiple files to a session with progress and error reporting.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a user message and handles assistant stub response.
